title: cert.rs Algorithm support doc comment is stale — says P-384 planned for pkix-path v0.2 without tracking issue
description: The validate_chain() doc comment states 'P-384 support is planned for pkix-path v0.2'. This is a vague forward-looking promise with no link to an issue or tracking state. Future readers cannot verify whether v0.2 shipped or whether this was ever actioned. Replace with a link to the upstream pkix-chain issue or remove the promise and just say 'P-384 CA certificates are not supported'.
